exposure: Gestational age at delivery (32, 33, 34, 35, or 36 weeks)
outcome: Maternal: Uterine rupture, hysterectomy, death,  total quality-adjusted life years (QALYs)
Neonatal: Hypoxic-ischemic encephalopathy, cerebral palsy, death, total quality-adjusted life years (QALYs)
cohort: Theoretical cohort of 1000 women with prior uterine rupture
finding: Cesarean delivery at 34 weeks gestation maximized maternal and neonatal QALYs in women with prior uterine rupture.
